ex.en: I'd like to open a savings account.
I put part of my salary into a savings account every month.
ex.zh: 我每個月把部分薪水存進儲蓄帳戶。

ex.en: No matter what your main purpose is in reading, books should never fail to provide contentment and satisfaction.
ex.zh: 不管讀書的主要目的是什麼，書總能帶給人滿足。

ex.en: I won't give them the satisfaction.
ex.zh: 我不會讓他們稱心如意的。

ex.en: Customer satisfaction is our top priority.
ex.zh: 顧客滿意是我們的首要目標。

ex.en: His low salary prevents him from buying the house.
ex.zh: 他薪水太低，買不起房子。

ex.en: His high salary enabled him to live in comfort.
ex.zh: 他的高薪讓他生活過得很舒適。

ex.en: I'll pay you back once I receive my salary.
ex.zh: 我一領到薪水就還你錢。
